scripts._comment_neoffice: //// Neoffice — `build` is gated: instances pull pre-built artifacts and must NOT rebuild (4 GB RAM = OOM-kill). Upstream `build` is kept verbatim as `build:force`. Set FORCE_REBUILD=1 to force it.
scripts.build: if [ -d 'wiki/public/frontend/assets' ] && [ -z "$FORCE_REBUILD" ]; then echo '[skip-build] pre-built artifacts present at wiki/public/frontend/assets (set FORCE_REBUILD=1 to force rebuild)'; else yarn build:force; fi
scripts.build:force: yarn tailwind:build && cd frontend && yarn build
scripts.theme:generate: node scripts/generate-public-theme.mjs && node scripts/generate-public-prose.mjs && node scripts/generate-public-lucide.mjs
